bunian.leyline_room_name: Moonlit Cempaka Bathing Spring & Spirit Arch

fox_fire_suzu_bell.name: Fox-Fire Brass Suzu Bell
fox_fire_suzu_bell.description: A consecrated brass shrine suzu bell etched with nine-tail Inari clouds; its clear chime parts the illusion veil of the Hidden Kitsune Village.

cempaka_brass_serunai.name: Cempaka Brass Serunai
cempaka_brass_serunai.description: A handcrafted Nusantara reed-and-brass flute carrying the timeless scent of white cempaka blossoms; opens the veiled paths of Kampung Kayangan Bunian.

bunian_female_regalia: Ivory-and-gold Nusantara royal songket kebaya labuh with golden cempaka cucuk sanggul hairpins
Emerald silk baju kurung songket woven with silver jasmine threads and draped selendang shawl
Saffron-gold embroidered kebaya diraja paired with a pleated sarong songket and filigree anklet bells
Moonlit celadon silk kebaya with intricate floral gold brocade and carved jade-and-gold hairpins
bunian_male_regalia: Ivory-and-gold royal Nusantara baju sikap with woven songket samping, folded tengkolok, and gilded keris sash
Deep emerald silk baju melayu cekak musang with gold-threaded songket samping and royal pending buckle
Crimson-and-gold pendekar baju sikap jacket over fine linen, bound with a sacred songket waist-sash
Midnight-indigo Nusantara court tunic embroidered in gold lotus filigree with a ceremonial folded destar

kitsune_roster_slots.personality: Regal, centuries-old nine-tailed shrine sovereign who speaks with playful courtly poise and fiercely upholds the Sanctuary Non-Aggression Pact.
Serene keeper of the Leyline Spirit Arch who reads starlight ripples and tests mortal sincerity.
Shrewd, silver-tongued apothecary brewing starlight elixirs and bartering warded Myōbu relics to trusted mortals.
Disciplined shrine sentinel patrolling the vermilion torii border against Syndicate poachers and occult cultists.
Inquisitive folklore chronicler fascinated by modern human smartphones, tea sweets, and urban legends.

kitsune_roster_slots.glamour_tell: a faint twin-tailed shadow flickering under lantern light and the warm scent of roasted sesame and shrine cedar
kitsune_roster_slots.personality: Playful young kitsune who slips into human glamour during the day to sample street-stall sweets along the Sanctuary tea steps.
Earnest, spirited young fox spirit tending the blue kitsunebi lanterns and eager to accompany friendly mortals on city delves.

bunian_roster_slots.personality: Ethereal, pure-hearted royal heir of the Orang Bunian who feels a quiet, destined longing toward the protagonist from first sight, hiding shy warmth behind courtly Nusantara grace.
Wise, soft-spoken custodian of ancient forest adat and treaties who honors courteous mortals and banishes Oath-breakers into the mist.
Master Nusantara metalsmith and songket weaver forging meteoric-iron keris charms and mist-warded regalia.

bunian_roster_slots.role: Veil Sentinel of the Banyan Gate
bunian_roster_slots.personality: Poised silat warrior-sentinel guarding the banyan mist boundary with wind-step grace and unwavering loyalty.

bunian_roster_slots.role: Keeper of the Moonlit Cempaka Spring
bunian_roster_slots.personality: Gentle spring keeper who distills moon-dew tonics and tends the glowing leyline orchids linking the two spirit enclaves.

bunian_roster_slots.glamour_tell: a lingering fragrance of white cempaka blossoms on windless air and slender pointed ear-tips half-hidden beneath dark hair
bunian_roster_slots.personality: Observant Bunian envoy who walks the outer cedar trails in human guise by day, quietly guiding lost hikers away from dangerous rifts.
Melodic courtier whose bamboo flute echoes across the reserve at twilight, curious about mortal music and stories.

kitsune_sovereign.name: Kitsunebi Ninefold Barrage
kitsune_sovereign.description: Unleashes nine orbiting azure fox-fire spheres that sear anomalous corruption.

kitsune_sovereign.name: Torii Mirage Veil
kitsune_sovereign.description: Wraps allies in refracting shrine mist, sharply boosting evasion and ward resistance.

kitsune_sovereign.name: Bewitching Suzu Resonance
kitsune_sovereign.description: Rings a sacred chime that disorients hostile entities and disrupts their focus.

kitsune_sovereign.name: Inari Sunlit Mending
kitsune_sovereign.description: Restores vitality and purges psychic static with warm golden shrine light.

kitsune_sovereign.name: Ultimate: Celestial Myōbu Nine-Tail Eclipse
kitsune_sovereign.description: Manifests the full nine-tailed celestial corona, incinerating hostile rifts while shielding the party.

kitsune_guardian.name: Fox-Fire Iaijutsu Slash
kitsune_guardian.description: Draws a spirit-wreathed shrine blade in a blinding vermilion arc.

kitsune_guardian.name: Flicker-Step Phantasms
kitsune_guardian.description: Splits into twin foxfire afterimages to evade incoming strikes.

kitsune_guardian.name: Shimenawa Spirit Bind
kitsune_guardian.description: Pins an enemy's shadow with consecrated talisman cords.

kitsune_guardian.name: Guardian's Shrine Ward
kitsune_guardian.description: Raises a vermilion torii barrier that absorbs incoming blows.

kitsune_guardian.name: Ultimate: Thousand-Torii Crimson Tempest
kitsune_guardian.description: Summons a corridor of spectral torii gates to blitz through every foe in foxfire.

kitsune_mystic.name: Azure Kitsunebi Wisp
kitsune_mystic.description: Launches homing spirit-lantern flames that bypass mundane armor.

kitsune_mystic.name: Aburaage Vitality Brew
kitsune_mystic.description: Infuses an ally with warm shrine spirit-nectar to mend wounds.

kitsune_mystic.name: Fox-Mist Confusion
kitsune_mystic.description: Blankets foes in illusory twilight fog, lowering accuracy.

kitsune_mystic.name: Starlit Tail Blessing
kitsune_mystic.description: Blesses the party with auspicious Inari fortune and critical focus.

kitsune_mystic.name: Ultimate: Star-Lantern Grand Exorcism
kitsune_mystic.description: Ignites a constellation of shrine lanterns that purges anomalies and restores ally spirit.

kitsune_myobu_beast.name: Spirit-Fox Fang Lunge
kitsune_myobu_beast.description: Darts across the battlefield as a silver-fast spirit fox, biting with foxfire fangs.

kitsune_myobu_beast.name: Multi-Tail Ember Sweep
kitsune_myobu_beast.description: Sweeps blazing spirit tails to scatter ghostly embers across clustered enemies.

kitsune_myobu_beast.name: Myōbu Howl of Warding
kitsune_myobu_beast.description: Lets out a crystalline spirit yip that sharpens party perception and dodge.

kitsune_myobu_beast.name: Shadow-Brush Pounce
kitsune_myobu_beast.description: Harries a target's flank, throwing them off balance.

kitsune_myobu_beast.name: Ultimate: Wild Myōbu Astral Stampede
kitsune_myobu_beast.description: Multiplies into a pack of blazing spirit foxes that overwhelm all hostile targets.

bunian_royal.name: Sinar Seri Kayangan
bunian_royal.description: Calls down a radiant beam of moonlit Kayangan grace that dissolves anomalous taint.

bunian_royal.name: Cempaka Royal Restorative
bunian_royal.description: Showers allies in fragrant golden cempaka petals, deeply restoring health and composure.

bunian_royal.name: Selendang Mist Sanctuary
bunian_royal.description: Weaves royal songket mist around the party, softening harm and hiding their presence.

bunian_royal.name: Titah Diraja Command
bunian_royal.description: Utters a sovereign Nusantara cadence that stills violent malice in enemies.

bunian_royal.name: Ultimate: Mahkota Kayangan Sovereign Bloom
bunian_royal.description: Unfurls the full majesty of the veiled Kayangan realm, healing allies and banishing hostile horrors in golden mist.

bunian_hulubalang.name: Keris Halilintar Thrust
bunian_hulubalang.description: Lunges with a sinuous meteoric-iron keris wreathed in emerald wind.

bunian_hulubalang.name: Langkah Angin Silat
bunian_hulubalang.description: Adopts a weightless Kayangan silat footwork stance to counter incoming strikes.

bunian_hulubalang.name: Banyan Root Snare
bunian_hulubalang.description: Commands spectral banyan roots to entangle an enemy's stride.

bunian_hulubalang.name: Pendekar Songket Aegis
bunian_hulubalang.description: Channels ancestral pusaka warding through gold-woven cloth.

bunian_hulubalang.name: Ultimate: Tujuh Lapis Pusaka Storm
bunian_hulubalang.description: Executes a seven-step Kayangan pendekar blitz that cleaves through every dimensional threat.

bunian_pawang.name: Serunai Resonance Bolt
bunian_pawang.description: Projects a piercing harmonic note that shatters unnatural distortions.

bunian_pawang.name: Air Embun Kayangan
bunian_pawang.description: Applies blessed moonlit orchid dew to mend wounds and fatigue.

bunian_pawang.name: Kabut Rimba Veil
bunian_pawang.description: Shrouds adversaries in disorienting primeval forest mist.

bunian_pawang.name: Semangat Rimba Blessing
bunian_pawang.description: Harmonizes ally vital spirit with ancient forest leylines.

bunian_pawang.name: Ultimate: Malam Berinai Spirit Chorus
bunian_pawang.description: Calls forth the unseen chorus of the elder woods to rejuvenate the party and purge corruption.

rumors.title: Blue Lanterns Beyond the Thousand Torii
rumors.text: Late-evening pilgrims along the Sacred Mountain Sanctuary swear the Thousand-Torii Fox Shrine Approach stretches further at twilight—and that the Omikuji stand sells an old Fox-Fire Brass Suzu Bell whose chime reveals a hidden lantern plaza.

rumors.title: Fragrance of Cempaka in the Banyan Mist
rumors.text: Forestry rangers at the Old Ranger Station speak of lost hikers guided home by graceful figures in gold-threaded songket near the Mist-Veiled Banyan & Bamboo Glade—and keep a curious Cempaka Brass Serunai traded by an unseen flute-player.

festivals.name: Night of a Hundred Fox-Fires
festivals.description: Paper fox masks and floating azure lanterns illuminate the Stone-Lantern Pilgrimage & Tea Street as the spiritual veil between the sanctuary and Sato-no-Inari grows paper-thin.

festivals.name: Malam Seri Cempaka Mist-Bloom
festivals.description: Luminous white cempaka blossoms bloom out of season across the Wilderness Forest Reserve while distant gamelan and serunai melodies drift from the Mist-Veiled Banyan Glade.
